name: Guess The Movie.Name
summary:
GuessTheMovie.Name is a daily puzzle game inspired by Wordle, Heardle & Framed.wtf.

Every day a new movie is selected and 6 screenshots from the movie are presented to you one at a time.

We try to have a selection of different movies from different genres and eras. We also try to have a mix of movies that are well known and movies that are more obscure. Generally harder movies are on the weekends, and easier movies are on weekdays.
